messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled prod rollout v1.13.0 -> 2026-03-21T15:00:00Z. Canary 5% across us-west-2. Change window: 15:00-17:00 UTC. Rollout ID: r-20260321-1130
alex: heads up — noticed a surge on inference-request queue, looks related to model-serving changes. can we pause the canary?
sara: @alex thanks. putting a hard hold on the prod rollout now. oncall investigating. please do not advance canary. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ops-bot: Incident alert: SVC-2314 "inference request queue saturation" assigned to sara. Incident link: https://incidents.internal/SVC-2314
jay: rough impact? should we roll back immediately or just stop the rollout?
sara: stopping rollout first (hold grabbed). early triage: a regression in kv-cache eviction under longer contexts. reproducing in staging. if quick fix not obvious, prefer rollback to v1.12.3 and pin until patch.
manu: agree with rollback if we can't get a safe mitigation in 30m. traffic at 15:00 UTC predicted to be heavy. recommend moving change window to tomorrow 04:00 UTC (low traffic).
kaitlyn: I'll run a focused regression test suite against v1.13.0 in staging now and try a config toggle that disables aggressive cache eviction. sharing logs in ~10m.
alex: I ran a query: errors spike when seq_len > 1024. adding note to incident.
sara: command to cancel canary: `/deploy cancel --id r-20260321-1130 --env prod` — can someone run it?
manu: running cancel now.
manu: ran `/deploy cancel --id r-20260321-1130 --env prod` — deploy-bot confirmed.
deploy-bot: Rollout r-20260321-1130 canceled by manu. Status: halted.
jay: ops/process check — we should pin global model alias to v1.12.3 so any automated fallback uses stable version. who can update release config?
kaitlyn: I can update the release config, will push change: `release.alias.set("model-inference", "v1.12.3")` and open a PR for the release notes entry explaining the emergency rollback.
sara: please also add a changelog note: "Rollback v1.13.0 due to kv-cache regression; pinned to v1.12.3; investigating fix." We'll need a backport plan.
ops-bot: Noted. Created ticket INF-4624: "Pin model alias to v1.12.3 and schedule re-rollout" assigned to kaitlyn, priority P1.
manu: new proposed window: 2026-03-22 04:00-06:00 UTC. Can we aim for canary then, with a canary traffic cap at 2% and additional preflight smoke + load tests?
kaitlyn: yes — I'll schedule preflight at 03:30 UTC, include automated perf checks and regression probes.
ajx: (typo) — sorry, ignore
jay: SLA/comms: should we send a short note to customers on the incident and delayed rollout? propose: "We paused a rollout of a model update after detecting elevated error rates for long-context requests. We rolled back to the previous stable model and will reschedule the update for 04:00 UTC 2026-03-22 after additional validation." good? :thumbsup:
sara: looks good. add a link to the incident page and a note that no data breach occurred.
kaitlyn: PR for release note in #repo/releases: https://git.internal/repo/releases/pull/457 — includes rollback note and planned window.
manu: ok reassigning the deploy slot. will re-open an SR with platform for a soft canary limit and stricter KV eviction thresholds.
sara: summary: hold taken, rollout canceled, pinned to v1.12.3, incident INF-4624 created, new window proposed 2026-03-22 04:00 UTC. keep this thread for updates.
alex: thanks everyone. ping me once preflight passes and I'll run the post-rollout validation checklist.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: preflight job r-20260322-0300 queued (owner: kaitlyn).
ops-bot: Incident SVC-2314 status: investigating -> mitigation in progress. updates in ticket INF-4624.
